subject: Org entry: technical kickoff & API key rotation plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminahealth.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@luminahealth.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Lumina initial tenant & access (MAP + SOW attached)

Hi all —

Quick handoff from CS: Lumina has signed and is ready to run the initial tenant activation sprint next week. Attaching the Mutual Action Plan and signed SOW. Key points: 

- Primary contact: Ethan Cole (engineering & platform) and Sara Lim (security).
- Initial scope: Create org, seed admin project, provision two API keys (one for dev/test, one for prod), create three roles (admin, engineer, viewer), and invite the initial 6 users.
- Timing: preferred kickoff slot week of May 22; Lumina requests a 60-min technical kickoff + 30-min security deep-dive follow-up if needed.
- Known constraints: Lumina prefers monthly API key rotation and wants to discuss KMS integration for long-term plans.

Next steps for implementation team (recommended):
1) Technical kickoff to review keys/roles/provisioning flow and map to their IAM.
2) Share implementation checklist and a draft invite cadence for admin seeding.
3) Confirm API key rotation policy and any KMS/HSM requirements before provisioning prod keys.

Attachments: Lumina-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (MAP), SOW_Lumina_2028-05.pdf

Thanks — I’ll stay on the thread for the first sync.

Monica
Monica Patel 
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Lumina initial tenant & access (MAP + SOW attached)

Thanks Monica — hi Ethan & team, excited to kick this off. I’ll be the technical lead from Redwood for the initial tenant build and invite flow. Proposed agenda (attached as redwood-kickoff-agenda.md):

- 0-10m: Introductions & goals for sprint
- 10-25m: Org/project model and role mapping (admin / engineer / viewer)
- 25-40m: API key seeding flow + environment separation (dev/test/prod)
- 40-55m: Key rotation policy, KMS integration options, and audit logs
- 55-60m: Action items & timeline (who does what by when)

Two things I’d like you to confirm before the call so we can prepare:
1) Do you expect to use customer-managed KMS (HSM) from day one, or is that a later step? If day one, please share KMS vendor and key access model (we’ll need a short checklist).
2) What rotation cadence do you want enforced automatically vs. manually? You mentioned monthly in the MAP — would you like Redwood to create the prod keys with a 30-day rotation TTL and delegate rotation to your infra team, or would you prefer Redwood rotate keys and notify you?

Proposed times: Mon May 22 10:00-11:00 PT, Tue May 23 09:00-10:00 PT, or Tue May 23 15:00-16:00 PT. I’ll hold Mon 22 10:00 as tentative if that works.

I attached an implementation-checklist.csv to show the typical tasks we run during the sprint (API seed, admin invites, role checks, baseline evals).

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0142

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@luminahealth.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 11:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Lumina initial tenant & access (MAP + SOW attached)

Thanks Monica / Priyom — appreciate the clear plan. A few answers and questions from our side: 

- KMS: We plan to use AWS KMS customer-managed keys for prod eventually, but for the initial sprint we can accept Redwood-managed envelope encryption as long as there is an agreed migration path. Sara (cc) will own the KMS conversation and can provide the key policy.
- Rotation: Monthly rotation is our preference, but we prefer automated rotation owned by our infra team. Ideally Redwood will seed keys and expose a rotation API so we can trigger or schedule rotations from our side. 
- Token consumption: For now we expect ~500k tokens/month on dev, ~2M on prod after pilot. If you have cost-saving suggestions (batching, quantization profiles) please include them in the kickoff.

Availability: Mon May 22 10:00 PT works for us. Please send a calendar invite. Also please include any pre-read on the invite so our security folks can review before the call.

On Thu, May 19, 2028 at 09:12 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick handoff from CS: Lumina has signed and is ready to run the initial tenant activation sprint next week. 
> Attachments: Mutual Action Plan, SOW.

Thanks,
Ethan Cole

ethan.cole@luminahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0224

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@luminahealth.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@luminahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 May 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Lumina initial tenant & access (MAP + SOW attached)

Perfect — locking in Mon May 22 10:00-11:00 PT and sending the invite now. I attached the kickoff agenda and a short pre-read that covers: how Redwood seeds API keys, our recommended rotation patterns, and the KMS integration options (hosted envelope vs. customer-managed). Key points up front: 

- For Hosted customers we support envelope encryption with customer-provided KMS keys for data-at-rest on Dedicated/Private plans; full HSM integration is available for Private deployments. We'll cover migration steps in the security deep-dive.
- We expose an API for key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke) that you can call from your infra; we'll demo it during the kickoff.
- Action items assigned during the call:
  - Redwood (Priyom): provision a dev API key and a seed admin user in the staging workspace by EOD Wed May 24.
  - Lumina (Ethan/Sara): share KMS vendor details and key policy doc by Tue May 23 so we can validate the migration plan.

Meeting invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123kickoff
MAP & SOW are saved in the HubSpot company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/companies/7890

Looking forward — I’ll circulate meeting notes and the invite with pre-reads attached.

Best,
